checks.title: display_errors is off in production
checks.why: With display_errors on, a fatal error prints file paths, query fragments and sometimes credentials straight into the response body.
checks.action: Set display_errors to Off and log_errors to On in the production php.ini, and confirm no code overrides it at runtime.

verify.expect: display_errors is Off and log_errors is On.

checks.title: OPcache is enabled in production
checks.why: Without OPcache every request recompiles every PHP file it touches, which typically costs several times the actual work of the request.
checks.action: Enable opcache in the production php.ini and set opcache.validate_timestamps to 0 so it does not stat files on every request.

verify.expect: The Zend OPcache module is listed.

checks.title: composer.lock is committed
checks.why: Without the lock file, production resolves dependency versions independently of what was tested, so a deploy can pick up a release nobody has run.
checks.action: Commit composer.lock and install from it in production rather than resolving fresh.

verify.expect: The path is echoed back, meaning it is tracked.
